about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

corn.fundamental: Mar corn is up slightly to ~453 in thin pre-Thanksgiving trade, lifted by the soybean complex; lagging US export pace remains the drag and there is no new demand news.
events: Corn starts Wednesday with thin trade (Barchart)
Corn exports lag into the holiday (Barchart)
Petrobras seeks more corn ethanol deals in Brazil (Reuters)

soybeans.fundamental: Jan has pushed to ~1,239 (+1.2%), clearing the November high and the 20-day momentum trigger on continued US-China deal talk, with meal again leading. Brazil's weather is still favourable, though forecasters flag a pattern shift ahead, which keeps a weather premium possible into December.
events: Soybeans tag their target on China trade talk (Barchart)
Brazil's weather holds up, but a shift looms (World Grain)
Jan ~1,239 midday, through 1,235 (CBOT/Yahoo Finance)

meal.fundamental: Meal Jan is up about 1.2% to ~355, extending its lead in the complex; strong meal demand keeps crush running hard and meal carries the margin. No new Argentine supply news.
events: Meal leads soybean complex higher again (CBOT/Yahoo Finance)
Strong meal demand boosts crush (Bloomberg)

oil.fundamental: Soyoil Jan holds near ~58.2, close to its nine-month low, as heavy crush for meal keeps adding oil. China's export surge is cooling as India turns to palm, a small help for US export competition, not enough to offset supply.
events: Soy oil hits nine-month low as meal demand boosts crush (Bloomberg)
China's soyoil export boom cools as India turns to palm (Bloomberg)

wheat.fundamental: Chicago Mar is down about 1% to ~583 as improving US winter wheat ratings and a forecast for Canada to rank second among exporters point to ample exportable supply.
events: Canada forecast to rank second in wheat exports (World Grain)
Winter wheat conditions improve for a third week (USDA via AgroLatam)
Mar ~583, -1% (CBOT/Yahoo Finance)

kc.fundamental: KC Mar is down about 1.2% to ~625, following Chicago; better Plains ratings keep 2027 HRW supply risk low and offer no new support.
events: KC Mar ~625, -1.2% (CBOT/Yahoo Finance)
Winter wheat conditions improve for a third week (USDA via AgroLatam)

cotton.fundamental: Mar is choppy around 81.5-82 in thin pre-holiday trade, giving back part of Tuesday's outside-market lift early before steadying. Nothing new on demand; old-crop Mar/May still leans on Texas Plains losses, while Dec delivery and high-grade certs keep the risk two-sided for longs.
events: Cotton fades in early Wednesday trade (Barchart)
Mar ~82 midday in light holiday volume (ICE/Yahoo Finance)
Broad risk-off as equities slide and VIX jumps to ~34 (WSJ, Yahoo Finance)

hogs.fundamental: Dec hogs fell another ~2.4% to ~50.6, a fresh 52-week low; weak pork demand and heavy Dec open interest into expiry keep liquidation going. Lower frozen pork stocks in the cold storage report are a modest offset that the market is ignoring for now.
events: Lean hogs fall to new lows on weak pork demand (The Pig Site)
Cold storage shows lower frozen pork, higher beef (DTN)
Dec lean hog open interest is large (ADMIS)

cattle.fundamental: Dec live cattle slipped about 0.9% to ~223.8, below 224.4 support, as funds trimmed risk alongside the equity sell-off; cash trade is still awaited. Supply stays tight, but higher beef in cold storage is a small negative for nearby demand.
events: Cattle correct with equities; cash awaited (AgWeb)
Cold storage shows higher beef supplies (DTN)
Feedlot supplies tighten (AgroLatam)

feeders.fundamental: Jan feeders dropped about 1.9% to ~326.7, through support and the 50-day average, following live cattle and the risk-off move. The closed Mexican border still keeps feeder supply tight, and screwworm remains the key tail risk.
events: Feeders slide with live cattle and equities (AgWeb)
Jan ~326.7, -1.9% (CME/Yahoo Finance)

class3.fundamental: Dec Class III bounced about 1.6% to ~17.2 with CME block cheese firmer, but milk output growth near 2% y/y still caps cheese; a slowing pizza market is a demand watch point.
events: Class III Dec ~17.2, cheese +1.6% (Yahoo Finance/CME)
Is a slowing pizza market bad news for dairy? (Dairy Herd)

class4.fundamental: Spot nonfat dry milk dropped 7 cents at CME, a soft signal for powder demand; Class IV futures barely moved, so the cash weakness has yet to feed through.
events: Nonfat dry milk drops 7 cents at CME (Brownfield)
Class IV Mar ~19.3, little changed (Yahoo Finance/CME)

palm.fundamental: India is turning back to palm after China's cheap soyoil exports cooled, a modest demand offset to China halting palm purchases. It does not change the picture of Malaysian stocks well above average, and weaker crude still narrows the biodiesel pull.
events: China soyoil export boom cools as India turns to palm (Bloomberg)
China halts palm oil purchases as storage fills (Bloomberg)

natgas.fundamental: Jan is softer near ~3.65 ahead of the holiday-shifted storage report, as strong production and mild weather outweigh LNG demand. Longer term, Europe's tight LNG balance and data-centre demand remain supportive.
events: Stout supply, weak weather soften natgas futures (NGI)
Germany secures Norwegian pipeline gas through 2044 (NGI)
Goldman sees US gas demand rising on data centres (OilPrice.com)

crude.fundamental: WTI Jan is up about 0.6% to ~83: an alleged Houthi strike on a Saudi refinery and Hormuz risk offset surplus worries, and China keeps buying the dip. OPEC+ policy is unchanged; Iraq is disputing OPEC's estimate of its capacity.
events: Oil rises after alleged Houthi attack on Saudi refinery (Reuters)
January crude higher early (ADMIS)
Iraq rejects OPEC capacity assessment (OilPrice.com)

ulsd.fundamental: ULSD Jan is near ~3.65, little changed; below-average distillate stocks and the alleged attack on a Saudi refinery keep the diesel risk premium in place.
events: Oil rises after alleged Houthi attack on Saudi refinery (Reuters)
Fuel tankers shift into crude trade on Iran war (OilPrice.com)

rbob.fundamental: RBOB Jan is down about 0.5% to ~2.43; gasoline stocks are steady and above average in the low-demand season, so the margin story stays weak despite firmer crude.
events: US gasoline stocks hold steady (OilPrice.com)
RBOB Jan ~2.43 (NYMEX/Yahoo Finance)
